half_note: client code (Assets/Scripts) and quest/config data (StreamingAssets/Quests, Resources/defaults.ini.txt) read. DOS data-pack half not in the box and not read. Server half: none (single player).
rule: Opt-in coach. A yes/no prompt at quest start, then pages that each fire either on a game-time timer (2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 9, 1, 1, 9, 3, 2, 2, 2 game minutes) or on a world event (dungeon exit, city arrival). Game time runs at 12 game seconds per real second, so one game minute is 5 real seconds. No ends the coach at any prompt. Main-story hook is a dated letter, random between 7 and 14 game days, with a 30-day reminder and a 14-day fail timer costing reputation.
keep: Opt-in coach with a yes/no at start and a No that ends it at any page
Event-gated pages (dungeon exit, city arrival) so the next page waits for the player
Escape is always allowed in the starter fight, and the coach says so
Dated main-story hook with a random window, so the player is not told the exact day
change: Text and timer come from one data field (page 6 says 10 seconds but the timer is 15)
Coach comes after the first ring fight, not before it
Hook window in minutes and visible in session (door, rival, rumour), not game days
Hit feedback is blood splash only in the files read; add hit stop and a flash at the first fight (parity row 10)
Dead waits of 45 seconds with nothing to do; replace with the next goal or cut

onboarding.1_first_90s: Character wizard (14 window setups, some path-only), three cinematics if enabled (data pack, not read), then tutorial yes/no and a wake-up narration; first page says check controls.
onboarding.2_first_fight: Starter cave: a rat with no treasure and an imp that needs steel. Escape is named as safe. No rig found in files read; spawns are data-pack.
onboarding.3_first_reward: Treasure pile on an altar with a remove-items inventory step. Loot ceremony not read. Level growth from skill use.
onboarding.4_first_hub: Travel to Daggerfall city, then talk for directions, shops, guilds, quest; one topic per page.
onboarding.5_first_choice: Fight or escape in the starter dungeon; join a guild or temple; accept or reject a guild quest.
onboarding.6_pull_forward: Timed pages to about 4 real minutes; event gates at dungeon exit and city arrival; dated letter 7-14 game days in; fail costs -15 reputation.
onboarding.7_style: Opt-in yes/no, timed pages, No ends at any prompt, 17 pages plus closing; show-and-tell.
onboarding.8_drop_off: Page 6 text-timer mismatch; 45-second dead waits; loiter skips the wait; text volume.
onboarding.9_idea: Opt-in coach after the first ring fight, event-gated pages, one data field for text and timer, in-session hook window.

look_test: Sixty-second first-run on the phone at 375 wide: variant A three timed coach pages (10 s, 15 s, 5 s real time) starting after the first ring fight; variant B the same pages gated on events (first hit landed, first win, zone enter). Dom judges readability at 375 wide and whether the timed version lands during a fight.
